name: chrysaki-statusline
description: The Chrysaki four-line statusline as a band above the prompt

barStyle.title: Bar style
barStyle.description: Progress bar glyphs. line draws filled and empty rules in the prompt colour

animate.title: Animation
animate.description: Scroll the wave bars and pulse the badge every 2 seconds

ruleAnimation.title: Animated row rule
ruleAnimation.description: Run a gradient along the dashed rule between ledger rows. It redraws the band every 150 ms

usdToSgd.title: USD to SGD rate
usdToSgd.description: Multiplier for the cost segment, as CHRYSAKI_USD_TO_SGD

cacheWarnLead.title: Cache warning lead
cacheWarnLead.description: Seconds before the prompt cache expires to warn. auto is 60 for a 5m TTL and 300 for 1h

cacheMinTokens.title: Cache warning minimum
cacheMinTokens.description: Warn only when a cold cache re-writes at least this many tokens

desktopNotify.title: Desktop notifications
desktopNotify.description: Send cache alerts through notify-send as well as a toast
